A Feral Tiefling runic-scribe, forties woman, indigo-violet skin and a thin whip-tail coiled at her ankle, in a long scribe-coat with ink-stained deep pockets and brass-rim spectacles, leather satchel of scrolls at her hip, chalking spiraling pact-runes across a floating parchment-sheet inside a towering lore-hall where hundreds of self-writing quills scratch in silent unison.

A Drow sorceress, mid-thirties woman, in obsidian-black velvet robes with a silver-crystal chest harness, glowing violet tattoos spiraling up her bare forearms, white hair pinned with a carved bone clasp, arms raised as wild-magic arcs crackle between her fingers inside a vaulted hall of floating arcane orbs.

A Tiefling warlock, late-twenties man, in black-and-violet pact-bound robes with a deep cowl pushed back, curved horns etched with fel-rune sigils, a glowing amber pact-amulet at his chest, one hand extended as shadowed tendrils coil from the flagstone floor of a torch-lit arcane sanctum.

A High Elf archmage, fifties woman, in deep-sapphire velvet robes embroidered with silver constellation patterns, a gem-capped ivory staff clutched in both hands, silver hair braided with runic beads, azure light blazing from her palms as she stands before a grand celestial-mapped dome.

A Dwarf runic-scribe, forties man, in a heavy canvas scribe-coat bristling with deep pockets, brass-rim spectacles perched on a broad nose, ink-stained fingers clutching a glowing etching-tool, leather satchel of scrolls strapped across a stocky frame, hunched over a luminous stone lectern in a rune-carved archive hall.

A Wood Elf druid, thirties woman, in layered leaf-green and bark-brown druid robes trimmed with animal-pelt, a staff of gnarled oak wound with living vines in her grip, amber eyes glowing faintly, arms spread as emerald light floods a grand hall whose pillars have erupted in flowering moss.

A Firbolg cleric, forties man, in cream-and-forest-green ceremonial robes with a broad holy-symbol gorget, a blessed cord wound about thick wrists, grey-green skin luminous with warm radiant glow, head bowed and both large hands clasped as golden light pours down through vaulted stained-glass windows above.

A Gnome illusionist, late-twenties woman, in layered rose-and-teal mage-robes stitched with tiny mirrored beads, small-framed with close-cropped copper hair, silver-wire spectacles on a button nose, nimble fingers weaving prismatic illusion-threads that scatter kaleidoscopic light across the polished marble floor of a grand illusory gallery.

A Half-Orc battle-mage, thirties man, in a sigil-engraved steel breastplate over slate-grey spellcaster robes, one gauntlet removed to free a casting hand blazing with orange rune-fire, a glowing runic blade sheathed at his hip, green-grey skin marked with old scars, standing wide-legged in a crumbling arcane fortress hall.

An Aasimar cleric, late-forties woman, in full-length cream-and-gold ceremonial robes with a braided silver cord at the waist, luminous bronze skin faintly haloed in white radiance, dark hair coiled under a gold circlet, both palms raised skyward as a column of holy light descends through the cathedral's rose-crystal ceiling.

A Shadar-kai necromancer, thirties woman, in bone-buttoned dark-grey scholar-robes with a hood draped back, pallid skin etched with faint shadow-markings, a skull-pendant resting on her collarbone, glowing teal rune-stones arranged before her on a stone table as she reads aloud from a hovering grimoire in a candlelit ossuary hall.

A Tabaxi elementalist, mid-thirties man, in deep-crimson robes trimmed with ember-orange flame-pattern, spotted feline fur visible at collar and wrists, amber slit-eyes reflecting firelight, a fire-bound staff gripped in one clawed hand, twin jets of controlled flame spiraling from his free palm across a vaulted hall of heat-shimmered stone.

A Sea Elf mage, late-twenties woman, in flowing aquamarine robes with wave-pattern silver embroidery, sea-glass beads woven through teal-streaked hair, glowing teal cuffs at her wrists, both arms extended as a dome of swirling water rises from a reflecting-pool in the center of a grand marble hall.

A Goliath elementalist, forties woman, in slate-and-white earth-toned robes with granite-shard trim, towering frame, grey-marbled skin etched with natural dark markings, a stone-bound staff planted firmly on the flagstones, hands aglow with amber earth-energy as chunks of flagstone orbit her in a wide, crumbling arcane chamber.

A Forest Gnome hedgewitch, fifties woman, in layered shawls of moss-green and rust-dyed wool over a linen tunic, bone-and-crystal necklaces stacked at her throat, herb-pouches dangling from a wide leather belt, small weathered hands cupping a glowing witch-stone as she murmurs over a summoning circle in a vaulted herbalist hall.

A Dunmer warlock, late-twenties woman, in black-and-deep-violet pact-bound robes with a high collar, ashen skin and crimson eyes sharp under a dark hood, glowing rune-tattoos tracing her collarbone, one slender hand thrust outward as violet eldritch fire crawls along the carved stone pillars of a shadowed arcane hall.

A Dragonborn archmage, sixties man, silver-scaled with a broad frame, in midnight-blue velvet robes sewn with golden constellation embroidery, a gemmed obsidian staff in one clawed hand, rune-glowing bracers at his wrists, head raised as spheres of compressed starlight orbit him beneath the great painted dome of a magical academy hall.

A Halfling sorceress, twenties woman, in deep-plum velvet robes with an amethyst crystal harness over the bodice, curly auburn hair loose around her shoulders, bare forearms lit with wild-magic sparks of pink and gold, standing on a stepped dais in a grand hall as chaotic energy fountains from her upturned palms.

A Genasi mage, forties man, wind-element with faintly luminous silver-blue skin and hair perpetually adrift on a sourceless breeze, in layered white-and-steel-grey robes with glowing-rune cuffs, a silver-tipped staff held loosely, cyclonic air currents lifting loose parchment in spirals around him in a high-ceilinged archive hall.

A Human runic-scribe, thirties woman, in a deep-teal scribe-coat with brass-clasped deep pockets, brown hair pinned under a soft cap, brass-rim spectacles smudged with ink, ink-stained fingers pressing a glowing runic seal onto vellum stretched across a luminous copying-stand in a candlelit hall of towering leather-bound shelves.

A Tiefling necromancer, forties man, in bone-buttoned slate-grey scholar-robes with a deep hood down, short dark horns, amber eyes calm and methodical, a carved skull-pendant at his sternum, glowing violet rune-stones orbiting his outstretched hands as he reconstructs a skeletal framework on a stone examination table in a lantern-lit crypt hall.
